informal_statement: Issue #290 E1 / gate D8b on the concatenation relation: an open history never closes with itself, and a closed one composed with itself always folds to +I. Complementary open pairs close to both +I and -I (minimal witness ^ and v). So the -I closure type has no homogeneous generator: N_hom = {+I}, N_mixed = {+I, -I}.

approximation_or_regime.name: Concatenation relation, fold types
approximation_or_regime.description: Composition = concatenation; type of a closed history = its fold (+I or -I), the single-body observational class.
approximation_or_regime.validity_limits: One relation and one type map. No advantage measure (D8c), persistence (D9) or physical relevance (D10).

formal_statement.statement_scope: All lengths for N1 and N2; explicit witnesses for N3. The N5 type census (|a|,|b| <= 3) is numerical.
